sentences.t: The bank split: the Nifty Private Bank index fell 1.85% and the PSU Bank index rose 2.46% in the same session, the only sectoral gainer.
Axis Bank fell 4.19% on a profit miss; Union Bank rose 5.25% on a margin jump.
Jio's record anchor book: nearly ₹2.5 lakh crore of demand for an ₹8,110 crore anchor book, more than 30 times covered, a first for an Indian IPO.
BlackRock, GIC, Norges and ADIA are in.
Yes Bank's AT-1 loss: the Supreme Court has upheld the quashing of its ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off; the bank must repay bondholders with interest.
The stock fell 14.5% on Thursday and fell again on Monday.
Results Monday: Bajaj Finance profit up 29%, Union Bank up 30.3%, Hindustan Zinc doubled to a record ₹6,412 crore.
UltraTech's 21% profit rise still cost the stock 2.4% on fuel costs.
Urban Company's loss widened and the stock fell 9.5%.
AI: Nvidia launched its enterprise agent model and two PC models, MiniMax says it cut agent costs 70%, and Meta open-sourced a 30B on-device agent model.
All three claims are the vendors' own.
Long read: Zetwerk, the factory that owns no factories, lists Friday with a 3-times-subscribed IPO and a FY26 revenue jump of 40%.
Its founder started with a software tool and threw it away in 30 days.
